title: Adventurous Scavenger Hunt in Minneapolis by Crazy Dash
includes: 2 hours with a remote interactive guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: In this fun Crazy Dash scavenger hunt of Minneapolis , players will use an app to find objects in the city, in any order they want, to collect points. They'll also complete challenges for points. Players can see their score on the app's live rankings. All scavenger hunts have a remote host to help along the way. Crazy Dash is our easiest and most casual scavenger hunt. Come explore with us in Minneapolis.
